entities.name: Matsya Kingdom
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Matsya was a Vedic kingdom and later became a part of sixteen Mahajanapadas, which also appears in Hindu Epic literature. The capital of Matsya was at Viratanagari which is said to have been named after its founder king, Virata. The name Matsya itself means "fish."
